subject: APAC marketplace payout shortfall, late fee & tax evidence
messages:
From: CloudBanc Billing <billing@cloudbanc.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0800
Subject: Billing notice: Marketplace settlement shortfall – action required

Hi Jordan,

During our September settlement run for ACME Retail (seller ID 9-AC-345), we identified a $24,213.50 shortfall on the marketplace payout tied to an unbilled usage window. The shortfall includes: 
- $22,000.00 net usage shortfall
- $1,763.50 GST (Singapore) discrepancy
- $450.00 late fee (per marketplace terms)

Attached: CB-INV-20261001.pdf (invoice), cloudbanc-reconciliation-20261007.xlsx (pivot + notes).

Next steps we need from Redwood:
1) Confirmation you received the invoice and the underlying usage export we attached.
2) Any evidence of a prior credit or adjustment on Redwood side that explains the $22k gap.
3) Clarify whether Redwood handled the GST as a pass-through or included in seller remittance so we can align tax coding.

If we do not hear back by EOD Friday (10 Oct), the invoice will move to collections and the late fee will be applied. We can provide a CSV extract of raw meter events on request.

Best,
Clara Nguyen
Ops & Settlements, CloudBanc
billing@cloudbanc.com

Attachments: CB-INV-20261001.pdf (invoice, 2 pages); cloudbanc-reconciliation-20261007.xlsx (notes)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Nguyen <billing@cloudbanc.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:40:00 +08:00
Subject: Fwd: Billing notice: Marketplace settlement shortfall – action required

Team — forwarding CloudBanc; putting this in our inbox. Quick ask: can Finance and Marketplace infra triage the $22k usage delta and the GST line? I suspect an APAC tax handling mismatch + a late ingestion window on 2026-09-28 that wasn't reconciled.

Desired in 48 hours: 
- A reconciliation snippet (csv or summary) showing the meter events for seller 9-AC-345 for 2026-09-20 -> 2026-09-30, with token counts and SKU mapping;
- A note on whether Redwood applied VAT/GST at checkout vs marketplace pass-through;
- If it’s our miss, propose whether we request CloudBanc waive the late fee and what evidence we should send.

I have ACE credit authority up to $5k — anything larger we escalates to finance leadership. 

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Lead, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
+65 9123 4567

--- Forwarded message attached ---

On Wed, 07 Oct 2026 at 09:12 CloudBanc Billing <billing@cloudbanc.com> wrote:
> … (original message)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 10:05:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing notice: Marketplace settlement shortfall – action required

Jordan / team,

Quick read and initial findings after pulling our settlement logs:
- Marketplace ingest shows an unassigned ingestion batch on 2026-09-28 23:40:12 UTC for seller 9-AC-345 totaling ~1.1M token-ops (estimated $21,800). The CSV export we have does not include that batch ID because it failed our shopper-mapping job (null tenant_id).
- Tax: our platform previously marked Singapore GST as 'pass-through' for CloudBanc listings (so CloudBanc normally collects/remits). That said, we added a new seller override in July which may have caused double-counting in CloudBanc's settlement engine.

Action items: 
1) Marissa — can you pull the per-batch meter export (raw events) and attach the export (CSV) to reply? Include batch ID and timestamps.
2) Karthik — please confirm whether the July seller override could duplicate a previously authorized offset. If it's a configuration bug we should patch and propose a corrective credit.
3) Jordan — I'll draft a short reconciliation note we can send to CloudBanc asking for a temporary hold on late-fee assessment pending verification.

If we can turn around an evidentiary CSV and the batch id to CloudBanc before EOD Friday, we should avoid collections.

Naomi
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

> On Wed, 07 Oct 2026 at 09:40 Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> > (forwarded to team)

From: CloudBanc Billing <billing@cloudbanc.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:18:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Billing notice: Marketplace settlement shortfall – action required

Jordan / Naomi,

Thanks for the quick reply. Per your note we attached an ACME-usage-export-202609.csv with raw meter events (tenant_id, timestamp_utc, sku_code, token_count, charge_usd). We also included a short reconciliation column that maps their batch IDs to our internal settlement rows.

What you sent looks consistent with our findings: the batch flagged by your team (batch_id 20260928-batch-zz7) is present in our raw ledger but wasn't previously reconciled because the tenant_id mismatch caused a failed join during settlement. We can hold the late fee if you provide the validated CSV and confirm you will submit a patch for the seller override (or we receive a marketplace-issued offset).

If Redwood supplies the per-batch CSV and a short note confirming the configuration fix, we will: 
- Reverse the late fee ($450.00)
- Apply an internal settlement credit of $22,000.00 against the next payout cycle
- Reissue the corrected invoice (CB-INV-20261001-CORRECTED)

Attachments: ACME-usage-export-202609.csv (raw events; 1.9MB)

Clara Nguyen
Ops & Settlements, CloudBanc

--- Forwarded data included ---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: CloudBanc Billing <billing@cloudbanc.com>, accounts-payable@acme-retail.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:24:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Billing notice: Marketplace settlement shortfall – action required

Clara / CloudBanc team — thanks. Confirming receipt of ACME-usage-export-202609.csv and our internal review: 

Summary of resolution: 
- Root cause: seller override introduced in July caused tenant_id to be written to the wrong mapping key for one ingestion batch (20260928-batch-zz7). That batch was effectively orphaned during our settlement join and therefore not included in the first pass.
- Fix applied: engineering patched the seller-mapping job on 2026-10-10, reprocessed the window, and validated the usage counts.
- Tax handling: Redwood did not remit GST for that seller; CloudBanc collects/remits (confirmed) — we will update our documentation to prevent future ambiguity.

Requested outcome: per your offer, please apply the $22,000.00 internal settlement credit against ACME's next payout and reverse the $450.00 late fee. Please reissue CB-INV-20261001-CORRECTED reflecting the credit and mark the ticket closed once done.

Internal note: this exceeds my $5k credit authority — Naomi, please confirm final approval for the $22k offset (I flagged this to you earlier).

Next steps: 
- CloudBanc: confirm when credit is applied and share the corrected invoice PDF.
- Naomi: please confirm formal approval and whether we should absorb any collection flagging costs.

Thanks all,
Jordan Blake
Account Lead, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME-usage-export-202609.csv (for reference), CB-INV-20261001.pdf (original attached earlier)
